body:
I promise there’s a dose of hope in this email!| | | |
---
| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138288653/643654802/-143260263?amount=50&refcode=260831em_tp_eom-pm&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjIxMDkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTI0OWI4MTQtOThhNS1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAyMjQ4MmE5YThkIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=QIU9ELTSD6ul6KIchz0pFUwehKHb5Wy-7x1JDbjMkRY=)
---
| | | Turn on the TV or scroll through social media on any given day, and you probably feel overwhelmed by the gravitational pull towards national insanity. _(Note: if you want to skip straight to the hope and inspiration part of this email, scroll down a few paragraphs!)_

We are back to seniors being forced to choose between medicines and meals. Families are back to playing health care roulette and unsure where the next meal may come from. Trump wants it to come from imported beef rejected by China, while our farmers get the shaft. Measles are back too, alongside the relentless grift of the Trump University and steaks era, but now being hawked from the Office of the President
The White House is a den of corruption, with presidential pardons for sale to the highest bidder and billion-dollar, no-bid contracts for cronies. And that doesn’t even touch on the absurdity of Trump watches selling out at $2,999 a pop. Or the serious threat to economic stability that comes from Trump selling Wall Street early access to his Truth Social posts designed to create artificial spikes in specific stocks and commodities.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138288658/643654807/-143260263?amount=25&refcode=260831em_tp_eom-pm&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjIxMDkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTI0OWI4MTQtOThhNS1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAyMjQ4MmE5YThkIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=QIU9ELTSD6ul6KIchz0pFUwehKHb5Wy-7x1JDbjMkRY=)
---
_(Yes, it really costs that much, and yes, it’s really sold out.)_

---
Here’s the good news – Americans are no longer entertained by this circus. Seventy percent of Virginia families are no longer buying the crap Trump is trying to sell. The majority of people in VA-05 are done with the corruption and cost spikes. They want sanity back at the wheel. They want Congress to do its job of serving as a co-equal branch and a check on this selling out of the American people.

I get a lot of daily reminders of why this job made a difference the last time I had the honor of representing the 5th District in Congress, nearly two decades ago. The daily train service to Lynchburg, the expanded rural health clinic in Nelson and Buckingham, the High Bridge Trail State Park in Farmville... we helped to make those happen! I draw so much positive energy from the people in our communities reminding me of the difference we made in the brief time we got to deliver for this region.

Leadership matters. Representation matters. When we held this seat, we put the American Dream back within reach for so many people. We protected our seniors and veterans, making tough calls to prevent Medicare from going off a cliff and finally reversing the burden of proof for our Vietnam Vets exposed to Agent Orange. We increased the minimum wage and shifted from bailing out Wall Street to economic relief for Main Street.

I am running not just to flip a seat but to make a difference in people’s lives. We can get costs down, paychecks up and corruption out.

A positive and proactive agenda, lowering costs, raising paychecks, restoring an affordable American Dream that leaves no one behind and a position on the global stage we can be proud of again.

I believe in all of that and so much more.

**Because of you, I am in a position to win. When I win, I will be in a position to make a difference. But we have not won anything yet, and the stakes remain astronomical. **

We’re so close to reaching our August goal, and with your help we can start September ready to hit the ground running.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138288662/643654810/-143260263?amount=25&refcode=260831em_tp_eom-pm&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjIxMDkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTI0OWI4MTQtOThhNS1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAyMjQ4MmE5YThkIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=QIU9ELTSD6ul6KIchz0pFUwehKHb5Wy-7x1JDbjMkRY=)**_

body:

Peter, it’s Bernie Sanders. Let me give you the good news and the bad news. **The bad news:** Donald Trump is rapidly moving this country into an oligarchic, authoritarian society and is continuing his attacks against the working class. **The good news:** The American people are catching on and fighting back. Not only are Trump’s approval ratings plummeting, but strong progressives are being elected all across the country. ** _But the work doesn’t stop there._ If you want to see a Congress with the courage to stand up to the insurance industry, the fossil fuel industry, big tech, and the oligarchs who control the political and economic life of our nation – we have to work together. [**_That’s why I am reaching out to you today. The Congressional Progressive Caucus PAC is dedicated to electing progressive leaders across the country and they need your support. Will you donate $27 (or anything you can afford) today? >>_**](https://act.weareprogressives.org/go/95319?t=9&refcode=EM_ALL_CPC_FR_5_2026-08-31_BER_EOM_ES-58950_RS&amount=27&akid=28063%2E3658908%2E3YnUlW) The political future of our country rests upon one very simple principle: **the need for working people to stand together, fight back against corporate greed and create an economy that works for all of us, and not just billionaires and large corporations.** We have to get involved in the political process — run for office, connect with our local, state and federal legislators, donate to candidates who will fight for the working class of this country. We have to create new channels for communication and information sharing. We have to volunteer not just politically, but to build community locally. We have to support progressive candidates running for office and push establishment Democrats to find the courage to take on the billionaire class of this country. And today, I am asking for your help to do that: [**_Please donate $27 or anything you can. body:
Measles is hurting all of us, even if we never catch it. It’s time we take this seriously.

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138290724/643674532/-463234460?refcode=emailheader&refcode2=5fd08264-9ca5-f111-9b33-0022482a9a8d&ms=260831_kh_eom2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWZkMDgyNjQtOWNhNS1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAyMjQ4MmE5YThkIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=DoebRJCFIZTCqd2Jg4mupb7tzqdFL3S8eCOZkb7C3TI=)
---
Friend, I’m outraged. This week, two people died of an entirely preventable disease. They were unvaccinated, and the likely cause for that was the misinformation machine that’s peddling lies about vaccine safety. Measles outbreaks aren’t just costing lives. A new [Washington Post](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138290725/643674533/143087067?ms=260831_kh_eom2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWZkMDgyNjQtOWNhNS1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAyMjQ4MmE5YThkIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=DoebRJCFIZTCqd2Jg4mupb7tzqdFL3S8eCOZkb7C3TI=&emci=2b03b43c-50a5-f111-9b33-0022482a9a8d&emdi=5fd08264-9ca5-f111-9b33-0022482a9a8d&ceid=28432238) analysis found that a measles outbreak infecting just 10 people cost taxpayers nearly $500,000 to contain. Right here in Texas, last year's outbreak took more than seven months to control and cost an estimated $18 million. Every dollar spent on emergency contact tracing and outbreak response is a dollar we didn't need to spend if this administration hadn’t undermined public health experts, let vaccination rates fall, and slashed public health funding. Aloha Peter, I know how fortunate I am to represent Hawaii. We are such a unique place, and one where the culture and language of our indigenous, Native Hawaiian community, in some degree, is part of our everyday lives. I use Hawaiian words as part of my day-to-day vocabulary, including these two: ohana, or family, and keiki, or children. Helping Hawaii’s families and children is one of the reasons I entered public service. It’s a responsibility I take very seriously. When I arrived in Hawaii at eight years old, my mother worked low-wage jobs with no health benefits, and I worried about what would happen if my mother fell ill. No child should face such circumstances. That’s why I’m fighting hard in the Senate to ensure that Hawaii’s families and our keiki have the resources they need to thrive. Republicans have chosen a different approach. Instead of fighting to deliver for working families, they’re selling our children’s futures down the river and kicking millions of Americans off their health insurance to line the pockets of their billionaire allies. **[I refuse to sit quietly while Republicans betray millions of people in Hawaii and across the country. That’s why I’m fighting to win back control of the Senate for Democrats. When I arrived in Hawaii at eight years old, my mother worked low-wage jobs with no health benefits, and I worried about what would happen if my mother fell ill. No child should face such circumstances. That’s why I’m fighting hard in the Senate to ensure that Hawaii’s families and our keiki have the resources they need to thrive. Republicans have chosen a different approach. Instead of fighting to deliver for working families, they’re selling our children’s futures down the river and kicking millions of Americans off their health insurance to line the pockets of their billionaire allies. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = = | = = | = = Mahalo, Mazie Friends of Mazie Hirono 335 Merchant Street #677 Honolulu, HI 96809 United States mailto:info@mazieforhawaii.com | Paid for by Mazie Hirono For Hawaii

**Because I _just_ debated 20 (mostly MAGA) baby boomers on Jubilee💀** | [

We discussed everything from turning out Gen Z voters to making our future work for _everyone._ And yeah, some of the participants yelled at me and pushed fake news😭

Now, I keep getting asked why I participated. And the answer is simple:

Organizing is all about talking to people about the issues they care about – especially the ones you don’t agree on. Because with all of our differences, there’s more common ground than you’d think!

And what most people don’t realize is that **the differences between our generations is smaller than most think.** Whether you’re 29 or 65, you’re being impacted by the lack of affordable housing, our rigged tax system that favors billionaires, and so much more!

**And that’s why we organize,_even if it means talking to (and getting yelled at by) 20 boomers._**

The far right wants us to be divided, but I refuse. Every part of the work we do, whether it’s showing up online or at the doors, unites us and builds the kind of future we deserve.

name: Derek Tran
subject: Hoping to connect with you.
body:
Friend, I'm glad I caught you.
I know I've been in your inbox a lot this week – sorry about that. This is the last one before midnight.
Aurash, my Finance Director, just gave me the update: we're about $5,048 short of our August 31st fundraising goal with just hours to go.
I'll be straight with you – CA-45 is one of the most expensive media markets in the country, and we're going up against outside groups who have been preparing for this race for months. Every dollar we close tonight matters for what comes next.

name: Citizens for Amanda Pusczek
subject: What we're up against heading into November
body:
We can’t wait our turn any longer, this is our moment.
---
| | | | | |
---
| | | In a moment, I am going to ask you to pitch in to our grassroots campaign for Congress here in Alabama’s 4th District to help us start September strong.

Here’s why:

For nearly three decades, Robert Aderholt has ignored this district while corporate interests called the shots. As a frontline registered nurse, I’ve seen what broken policies look like up close: rural hospitals shutting their doors, working families bankrupted by basic healthcare, and kitchen tables stretched to the breaking point by rising costs.
Now, the establishment is counting on us to stay quiet and accept uncontested elections. They want everyday working people, farmers, caregivers, and families across our counties to feel like our voices don't matter.
Context is important:
* Rural healthcare access across Alabama continues to erode while politicians look the other way.
* Working families are paying higher prices at the grocery store and the pump.
* Corporate PACs and entrenched incumbents are pouring millions into keeping power away from the people.

They want us to believe change is impossible in AL-04, but they cannot take away our power when we stand together. Our answer is to organize, speak up, and show up across every community in AL-04.
I am not taking corporate PAC money, which means reaching voters across all 13 counties takes real grassroots fuel.
**[Will you make a $5 contribution—or whatever you can afford—to our campaign?](https://nkkyj.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeFuBlbHXW2Bm5gyt6pF3/KlFIEInQeDZS)**
**Every dollar adds up when we build this movement together.**
**Thank you,****Amanda Pusczek****Democratic Nominee for Congress, AL-04**

# PRESS RELEASE

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
August 31, 2026

**CONTACT**
Todd Cheewing
Todd@Ascent-Strategic.com

**LILY TANG WILLIAMS DOMINATES WMUR PRIMARY DEBATE, DELIVERS COMMANDING VICTORY**

MANCHESTER, N.H. — Lily Tang Williams delivered a commanding victory in tonight’s WMUR Republican primary debate, demonstrating exactly why she is the strongest candidate to win New Hampshire’s Second Congressional District.

Williams was clear, confident, and unapologetic, laying out a strong vision to confront kitchen table issues that all Granite Staters are concerned with now — the cost of health insurance, groceries, and gas, among others.

“Tonight, Granite Staters saw the difference,” said Williams. “I know what I believe, I know who I’m fighting for, and I’m ready with a campaign strong enough to take that fight to Maggie Goodlander.”

Williams entered the debate as the clear Republican frontrunner and walked off the stage having reinforced her position to win this race in November.
**About Lily Tang Williams**
Born in China just before Mao’s Cultural Revolution to working-class parents, Lily Tang Williams immigrated to the United States with nothing and built a life as an entrepreneur, educator, and community leader in Weare, NH. A living embodiment of the American Dream, she brings a uniquely powerful perspective to the fight for freedom and limited government.

In 2024, Williams won the Republican nomination and captured 47% of the general election vote against current incumbent Maggie Goodlander — coming closer than any Republican has in more than a decade to flipping NH-02. She is back and running stronger than ever in 2026.

_**Breaking via Albuquerque Journal:**_
**“..._closer-than-expected_ margin in New Mexico’s race for governor”** **_Thank you._ Friend, because of you, we just pulled ahead in the polls.** All the support folks like you have given this campaign has helped us travel across this beautiful state, talk with New Mexicans, and make our case for a better future. Thank you. **But our lead is still far too close for comfort, and with 63 days left, we have no time to let up. My Republican opponent is already pointing to this poll to tell voters this is a competitive race that he can win. Friend, he’s right about one thing: This race is not decided yet.**

**_[We’re at a critical moment in this race, and we need everyone with us. Will you chip in $5, $3, $1 — whatever you can — before midnight? Every dollar helps us reach voters across New Mexico, compete with Republican spending, and defend our lead.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/15433?refcode=jtk1301-fr-nd&amount=5&t=2&akid=12146%2E400544%2EEmAnbi)_**

_**But now we have to protect this lead.**_
I’m fighting to lower costs, put money back in New Mexicans’ pockets, strengthen our schools, protect our public lands, build safer communities, and stop anyone who would bring an extremist agenda to our state.
My opponent wants to bring Trump’s extreme agenda to New Mexico. He is ready to cut Medicaid, SNAP, and universal childcare — programs New Mexicans depend on to get ahead. **Republicans are coming for this seat. **That’s why, with just weeks until Election Day, we have to keep fighting.** We’ve set a $75,000 goal that we need to hit before our end-of-month deadline at midnight tonight. **_[Please chip in $5 or whatever you can spare to help me win this November so I can keep fighting for New Mexicans and deliver for working families.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/15433?refcode=jtk1301-fr-nd&amount=5&t=4&akid=12146%2E400544%2EEmAnbi)_**

What does it actually mean to win... not just in November, but _after_? Fighting back against Trump and holding this administration accountable when we regain the majority is non-negotiable. _But simply being anti-Trump is not a real platform — and it’s definitely not enough to win an election._ _We need to be clear about what we want, not just what we don’t_**.** It’s on Democratic leaders to think creatively about the issues we’re facing, come up with solutions and draft the legislation, and work to get true buy-in from our colleagues, constituents, and advocates. We can do this work now so that we’ll be ready to hit the ground running as soon as we regain the majority in November. That's what I've been working toward. Every bill I've introduced this cycle — on AI, child care, fertility access, data privacy, protecting workers, and more — is part of seeding the ground now so we're ready to jump into action in January. I want Democrats to govern and govern well. **I want us to prove to the American people that we have real solutions to their problems, and the political will, courage, and strategy to deliver them.** I'm genuinely excited about what's possible if we win. And I believe we will get to do all of it, if we continue to work together towards our shared goals. clean_body: It’s not a platform| | | | = What does it actually mean to win... not just in November, but after? Fighting back against Trump and holding this administration accountable when we regain the majority is non-negotiable. But simply being anti-Trump is not a real platform — and it’s definitely not enough to win an election. We need to be clear about what we want, not just what we don’t. It’s on Democratic leaders to think creatively about the issues we’re facing, come up with solutions and draft the legislation, and work to get true buy-in from our colleagues, constituents, and advocates. We can do this work now so that we’ll be ready to hit the ground running as soon as we regain the majority in November. That's what I've been working toward. Every bill I've introduced this cycle — on AI, child care, fertility access, data privacy, protecting workers, and more — is part of seeding the ground now so we're ready to jump into action in January. I want Democrats to govern and govern well. I want us to prove to the American people that we have real solutions to their problems, and the political will, courage, and strategy to deliver them. I'm genuinely excited about what's possible if we win. And I believe we will get to do all of it, if we continue to work together towards our shared goals. | Dear Peter,
Today is Primary Day in Massachusetts; and your vote is how we start to change the direction of this Commonwealth.
For too long, one-party control has gone unchallenged. That only changes when Republicans show up. Every ballot cast today tells the rest of the state that we will not sit this out.
Please vote. Bring a neighbor. Bring a friend. Then tell two more people to do the same.
How to vote
* Find your polling location: [Vote.massgop.com](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001J3gBGqfECvfYxgkFNSdS0j7KMVyfFjquNOjfzekr9Q6Kn-71Lra_R-F54gVD88cWyW6HlxkIJR9rtb4r4Ng87O0_wscgSG065G5T6KsuZl8g_T8RxKkK-ZlaYX2-EoVV4WUEpdD4PM3AXFXdYnq71lhr-V01s5Xa&c=qtrldJfyO-yGBieV_kwHGAjOAOBpwWyxw-Rhr2gkvIIEzyii_Zq6QA==&ch=Weq6lQuevdg_fKGJiCHiGRPPBa3eoQbwu5jG3-V47uqK-7fDZY3lVA==)
* Polls are open 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.
* If you already voted early, thank you -- now help someone else get to the polls.

Call the MassGOP Election Integrity Line: 617-231-9856
Do not argue at the polling place. Document what you observed, get the precinct and time, and call the number above.
Massachusetts will not become more competitive because we hope it will. It becomes more competitive when Republicans vote, in September and again in November.
Thank you for doing your part today.
Sincerely,

Attend Election Integrity Training Before November!
No images? [Click here](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-e-fyukklk-didthutlhu-jj/) [](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fyukklk-didthutlhu-r/) Patriot,**_Election Integrity Update_** The **November General Election is approaching** , and Wisconsin needs dedicated volunteers ready to do their part to ensure secure, transparent elections.Election observers and poll workers play a critical role on Election Day--helping ensure election laws are followed, promoting transparency, and protecting the integrity of the voting process.You can make a difference. Whether you're ready to serve as an election observer or you're already a Republican-nominated poll worker, now is the time to get trained, get prepared, and commit to serving this November.Don't wait until Election Day. Create or access your volunteer account today using the link below and join the Wisconsin Protect the Vote team.**Step up. Get trained. Be ready. Protect the Vote this November.** [Sign Up For A Volunteer Account](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fyukklk-didthutlhu-y/) **_Upcoming Training Sessions_ - Election Observers or Workers**Election observers and workers fill vital roles in ensuring election integrity. They receive the training they need to identify Election Day irregularities and support our rapid-response team of legal professionals.Election observers and workers primarily oversee **early vote and election day processes.** All observers participating in the Protect the Vote election observer program are _required to attend one training session._ Below are training sessions offered statewide. Soon after Communist State Representative Angie Nixon stunned the Democrat establishment by crushing Alex Vindman in Florida's U.S. Senate primary, official public records reviewed by Loomered.com reveal a decade-long paper trail of 'careless' driving citations that culminated in an October 2019 crash in which Nixon injured her minor daughter after veering into oncoming traffic.
Public records from the Florida Highway Patrol and the Jacksonville Sheriff's Office show Angela Monique Nixon (DOB 02/27/1984) was cited over and over again for the same offense:
* January 3, 2009: **Careless driving** for failing to maintain control of her vehicle on SR-9A. Crash with $1,200 in property damage.
* October 28, 2010: **Careless driving** for failing to stop at a blinking red light. Crash with $4,000 in property damage and 3 injuries.
* January 23, 2013: **Careless driving** after she rear-ended a stopped vehicle. $5,000 in property damage, with an injury code noted on the report.
* October 23, 2013: **Careless driving** after she again rear-ended a stopped vehicle. $1,500 in property damage.

| Since Trump returned to power, hordes of brainwashed MAGA faithful have been unleashed to threaten judges who rule against Trump with violence and even death.

## Supreme Court OKs Trump's Ballroom
The Supreme Court [cleared the way](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OpDAQhJ8GMiPbmB8HDi4hm0svRMZuBt8ZGtkN1r39aka7yaYblkoq1ff9ecwPG2I4nr_tDoZWnA8oOQIRpDlfZ4IdHF6J8F9ebIwJccd7llz2jGvGxWwdhRtmZWtvVgAJbQ1GDOMou0GKtt4MrNJrb0dttYfWi0WPbh20WvggFXhXB_Pa45oLwXnf8cZp1bmeCzuKRbW6rRQHHwhT8xfDQRus8T_ekBqHex3NRnTmqv1VyamSUymlORb34nj1lZxOjIGCy5WcPpHYm-l7ZjZGLJlRuvaT7XgDWzEVmzwrWyBgG14Z2JcH5vDIlC5HLLnDdlpxPdTJ-LOEGEPuh0rx525DfP-kH-q9jfwIAAD__yn_lNw) Monday for President Trump to continue construction on the $400 million White House ballroom, ruling 5-4 that the group suing to stop it likely has no legal right to bring the case. The justices [did not decide](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OnTAQhZ8GOl_5Fy6FizS327Qp0WCGxYlhkD1g7dtHXCVPsNVIc6Sj832_PsYPiCnunz9hQ88LjTvWkpAZ81jOI-OGgc7M9KdMkFIm2ugatdSdkIOQaoTA8cLRQjv7BVGjadGr_vnUrtfKtKsHJ6HXdoIe3eLsZNzsAPpgpZmtAdVGf_fJQSolZefkIwzWhU4qeKrJmsE0VuIcmfLjN8WdV1zSF12YH4G2NvmV-SiN-dHoV6NftdZHzXzdYaNfN899gCPtkMRBKXIM9-8fn3gDipAQchEVvsRCWXA-t0MwiUA7x_1EUdfIKFY6C4r_Lu60cD7D3d5mPx81phRL1zdWfm4Q03sjf1Pt5fXfAAAA__8sRJOR) whether the project itself is legal. The challengers argue that building on federal land in Washington requires the "express authority of Congress." The majority said that objection amounts to "mere offense, disagreement, or distaste," which does not qualify as a legal injury. Chief Justice John Roberts sided with the court's three liberal justices in dissent, writing that the construction is "likely unlawful." Read the [ruling here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGTpCAQRn8NZmM1DSoEBJeYzaUXUojtDLdoW8ho7b_fmo023-jLvvfq_bv7e0g5bY-_YSVXF_YbXUemWqn447UXWinyq1T-OKaQc2Fe-fQI2N_A3kD6EGs6yevQzG4hQlINOTkYg92AUjVPBxAJzKS0GcCaaIyNQQ_SLp2BKURsknv_gQUpAfoO2mh1F3uQwchJK6uEBppT5dL-57TVJy35k08qbeS1ye5Z634I9UfgKHC8rqv9ad4--BQ48p62xNshcMRun5f39gFBeZwMtfu8NMXN-5VyTkc_CA2PNaT8jai_LHM6_AoAAP__HLF30A). The administration says the project is already 65% complete, with crews working 20 hours a day, seven days a week. The lawsuit itself [continues in court](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFugzAQxvGnMRvofAZjBg9d2NK1I3LMEdwaHJkLVt--StQ-QeeT_qff93GZLi7EsN_e3UaWlzTtVI5IzJSn43HPtJFPj8zp67i6GHNKWzonBNQ1DDXIyXkOJ02tq2a7ECGpiqzsjcGuR6mq1XYgl0U7v8A8z8PQO009OmUMKkNSYxXsswcDSAmgO2j80HZeg3RGXls1KNECzYFTbj5T2HmlJX6nk3Lj01ZFuzLfD6HeBI4Cx1JK4_erfx4Fjs-0wBGMwFFJgeOvqn6x6rIGpnpNj4PqP2Cz8harbOd7CTGGQ_eihdvmQnw95H_udFr8CQAA__-f1ny8).
## 2 Dead, 15 Missing in Grand Canyon Rescue
Two people are dead and about 15 remain missing after [flash floods tore](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL-OhCAYxJ8GOwyCfwuKa-z22ivNJ3yu3CKfAdTs21_cV7huMpNMZn4_j-kBzrvw_IYNdV5oCngljzljnNKxR9zQ0BEzvdIM3keijc5JCtlyMXBRTWCyO3GqobB6QZSoCtRV1_ey6WSlilU3japbhNZKBXPdLXbolV0W2wows2nmwum7TwyiqoRoG1GaoW5MKyroq7lWg2K1QOsyxfKXXMgrLv5NJ8bS0FZ4vea8J6a-mByZHK_rKs2c7h93zuR4SybHZ4RguYHwpsADZEcBPN8hvvjiiSzHE8zx8fmK3hnaM0YeMZkD-b5CyLTxCMGsTI5F1Ha_nPcutR2rxXMD5z-D8j85nlr-BQAA___JVIwj) through the bottom of the Grand Canyon, park officials said Monday. About 60 campers fled across a footbridge minutes before the water destroyed it, then were flown out by helicopter. One told the media it "would have been game over" if a ranger had not ordered the evacuation. [The park says](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D1u4zAQQOHTUJ2N4fC_YLFYQFvZWCBFSoGSRjYTSjRIWo5vHzhXSPuKr3jvp-EUYorb5RxW8m3Jw0aPmqg1KkO93wqtNOV7afmzjiGlkvOa9wEB9QHcAfgQphZ3GmToZr8QIYmOPDfWojLIRXf1oxvnWWiNhhM3FNCZEBYrUVlLBnQX_csDB5wDaAXHyUk1aeDB8lEKJ5gEmmPL5fiR49autKRn3qkcp7x2yV9bu1Um_jDsGfZfr8qw_1fCNv8N2zNv5_9vDPvaQrtXhj2Ck1KBdCiU4VY5obri59sjphSrNkzCZQ0x_fDtl1d2j98BAAD__1JUdBk) nearly all footbridges in the flooded area are gone, and about 40% of the pipeline supplying its water was damaged or destroyed. Phantom Ranch, the popular lodge at the canyon floor, is closed indefinitely. The search continues under threat of more storms, with forecasters warning of "raging killer currents" in side canyons. The park is asking anyone who knows of hikers who were in the area Saturday to come forward.

Google Maps [began showing](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1urDAURlcDnZF_wEDh4jV089qUyJgL3IzNRbaBzO6jSZaQ8pM-HR2dj8f4sOhxX__bACYvNO5wJw85QxzTeUQI4OiMmZ5pst5HokDXKLnUjPeMi9G6jBeMtS1nswBIUCUY0XadbFopVLmZRjvXdrqdla5lO_VKtl2vhbIdyM6pvkTz5vGeC8G5bnjl-rpxmgvbialWvSpqDjNmitUn4Z43WPyLLoiVo1B6s-V8pEL9K-RQyOG-72qhr-lMuENK708hB48LpPzyUMhhJVo9sGCPxNxm9xUS8_YJjPZsI9LvsAEiOsvOxM4EMbEcz3AwijNEhjkxWhZ0aH0ZzXzc6D0m3RY1X4NF_6OW_1j0MvI7AAD__9gQjsk) "Lake America" to American users Saturday, after the federal names database formally adopted President Trump's order renaming Lake Ontario. Not everyone is falling in line. MapQuest [flatly refused](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OpDAQBOCngaxH_gHMBA4uIdtLL0Q9ptnxre1Gdg9o3_409wobV-lTqf58rB8YUyyfvzGTl53XQldLJEJ1ba-jUqbAryr81R6YUmXOfK5GmQnUHZReMUg8aR2w3_xOZMj25LWbZzM6o23_9DjZedTWzmFSTu9qIzPa3Wp008M55fro3566K62VmkZ1C_dhDJPSOOvHYO-2GxRtUbje_nIs8qQ9ffNJ9RY498k_RY7W2V-dWTqzXNd1C4XkHXZmEQrPziyN6hkDNcCyQeNdLqz0bseUIOMBeBwNKhXMBAm_CLgI1siAu1AFqa98NOC6UYUoDYQZGnMBYWj43Zmlr3473l5sk-sG9Zkxpv8T5YfPnt78CwAA__-eg5B6), posting, _"We're not changing the name of Lake Ontario."_ The White House brushed off critics, claiming most of the lake's volume sits in U.S. territory.

Over the past few days, I have seen any number of "good" Democrats say a lot of things (some of them unprintable) that boil down to "You voted for him. We told you so, who cares if you lose that farm." In some of the comments, their joy is palpable.
First, Democrats can't complain about divisiveness, then, when they have a chance to be better, join in the nastiness of modern American politics. Second, Democrats have to accept we have not articulated a coherent rural policy in decades. What reason did we give farmers to vote for us? The fact that we surrendered hundreds of seats in rural areas without contest says a lot.
Many Democrats running in Alabama this year are trying to offer a different approach to rural voters. We want them to know we've heard them and that we will fight to rebuild failing infrastructure, like water and sewer systems. We're going to fight for new infrastructure, like getting high-speed internet to every home in the state. We'll work to shrink the healthcare deserts in rural areas. We'll fight to improve the quality of rural schools, but we will never get elected if all Trump voters hear is, "We told you so..."

All of the times you’ve stepped up to support the President, all the surveys you’ve submitted, all the petitions you’ve added your name to, and all the grassroots donations to support America First candidates... ...It’s all led to this moment! But along with the historic honor of being named our movement’s MVP comes a vital responsibility. With the final 2 years of Trump’s presidency hanging in the balance, Republicans must UNITE at our first-ever Midterm Convention and put forward a WINNING platform. But MAGA gets it – that winning platform can’t be written by politicians. It can ONLY be written by grassroots patriots... ...and not just any patriot, but our movement’s MOST VALUABLE PATRIOT. That’s why we’re giving YOU the responsibility of setting our convention agenda! This isn’t about your physical attendance at the convention. Instead, it’s about getting the insight and wisdom from our single most dedicated grassroots supporter who will help guide President Trump and MAGA to victory when we need it most. Paid for by America First Majority PAC.

Brandon is back for round two, and we've got a lot to cover. We get into Tennessee's abortion ban and a personal bill I brought to add narrow exceptions, a wave of bills passed after Charlie Kirk's death that Brandon and I think function more like censorship than free speech, and some of the most brazen corporate giveaways I've seen in a while, including an entire regulatory framework built for one billionaire's Nashville tunnel project.
We also talk about a real bipartisan win: a voting rights restoration bill that took years to pass, and close on what's _actually_ giving Brandon hope right now.
This one covers a lot of ground, and I hope it sheds some light on what's actually being prioritized in our state legislature.

# Convenience over Compliance
| |
---
|
---
We were recently contacted by the families of two students newly enrolled in health-related fields at Baylor University in Waco. Both students submitted the appropriate exemption paperwork as required by state law, yet **both exemptions were denied.** After reaching dead ends with the university, the families reached out to TFVC for help. Armed with the pertinent statutes establishing the students’ rights to exemptions, TFVC President Rebecca Hardy sent [this email](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/tb/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTk3NDEwMDY3MDkyMzQyMzM1LFwiclwiOjE5NzQxMDExMzg0MTAwNjE3MX0iLCJzIjoiMzE2ZDBjMTU2YjQ1YTM0NyJ9) to Baylor officials. _**In less than a week, Baylor’s legal counsel responded.**_ **The Good News:** Baylor acknowledged students’ right to claim exemptions and reaffirmed that the University does not require influenza or COVID-19 vaccination for enrollment. Baylor also updated [its handbook](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/tb/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTk3NDEwMDY3MTAxNzc5NTIzLFwiclwiOjE5NzQxMDExMzg0MTAwNjE3MX0iLCJzIjoiOTBhOTY0NDU4Y2QzMGRkMSJ9) to clarify this and the distinction between enrollment requirements and clinical placement requirements. **The Bad News:** Baylor has opted for **convenience over compliance** when it comes to clinical placements, requiring proof of vaccination ahead of enrollment in case available clinical sites might not accept exemptions. [Baylor’s legal counsel explained](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/tb/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTk3NDEwMDY3MTEyMjY1MzAzLFwiclwiOjE5NzQxMDExMzg0MTAwNjE3MX0iLCJzIjoiZDJkNjYyMGQyNTkxNGU1OSJ9) that “ _asking for a religious exemption during the process of allocation of clinical placements can seriously delay the final determination of a student's placement and may delay the completion of the program by one or more semesters._ ” To be clear, obtaining exemptions at clinical sites may be challenging for healthcare students, **but it is not impossible** , and universities cannot deny enrollment based on a student’s potential desire to seek an exemption at a future clinical placement. Conflating clinical-site requirements with university enrollment requirements - and **using the former to effectively nullify the latter** \- is an egregious overreach by programs that students are paying to attend. **Ensuring future healthcare providers have the same right to informed consent is TFVC’s top priority for the upcoming 90th Legislative Session.** If you or someone you know has been denied an exemption as a healthcare student or healthcare employee, please reply with your story. _Your experience may help inform our legislative efforts to end vaccine-based discrimination._

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bfc64937-9b9f-4164-93e1-709b6c778da8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Republican gerrymandering in North Carolina handed Donald Trump[ control of Congress](https://substack.com/redirect/ad88970a-9583-4d73-b544-dd944559ff34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the last election. Trust me, I know -- my seat was one of them. Now another round of Republican gerrymandering may hand Trump control of the next Congress.
I want to show you three numbers. They tell the whole story of how gerrymandering has rigged the House against Democrats, and why this is our last chance to fix it.
### **16.**
That's the head start Republicans had going into last year. Democrats gerrymander in some districts, but Republicans do it a lot more. The [nonpartisan Brennan Center](https://substack.com/redirect/20c1aa82-d797-4f58-a0e9-c984503514c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) did the math. They found that rigged maps gave Republicans a built-in advantage of about 16 House seats after the 2024 election. That was before Texas, North Carolina, and other states started gerrymandering last year.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/158185cc-30d1-46d4-9f84-e10800c5be05?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Here's how they got that number. Republicans gerrymandered themselves 23 extra seats. Democrats gerrymandered 7. Subtract one from the other and Republicans come out 16 seats ahead. That's not because more people vote Republican. It's because Republicans are able to gerrymander in more states, and they're just more ruthless than Democrats when they have the power.
Sixteen seats is a lot. In a House this close, control usually comes down to a handful of seats. So a 16-seat head start is a massive advantage.
I know from experience. The three seats Republicans gerrymandered in North Carolina, [mine included](https://substack.com/redirect/80b3c9d4-28cf-443f-8083-295077ccfac5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), were the difference in control of Congress. Had I been allowed to run in my fair district, I would have been the 218th Democrat in the House, making Hakeem Jeffries the Speaker by ONE vote, 218-217. Trump's Big Ugly Bill would have failed and we'd be living in a very different country right now with Democrats holding a check on Trump.
### **26.**
That's roughly where we are now, after the past year.
Last summer, Donald Trump told Republican states to redraw their maps in the middle of the decade. That's not normal. Maps are supposed to be drawn once every ten years, after the census. Trump wanted them redrawn early for one reason: to steal more seats before the 2026 election.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bfc64937-9b9f-4164-93e1-709b6c778da8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Ten states redrew maps. Democrats fought back hard. California voters passed a map that canceled out most of what Texas did. For a while we fought it to a draw. Then Republicans added seats in places like North Carolina. Virginia's Supreme Court threw out new Dem-leaning maps. And the Supreme Court stepped in for Trump, gutting the Voting Rights Act, and opening the door for Republican states across the South to erase Voting Rights Act seats held by Democrats.
When the dust settled, Republicans had padded their lead by about 10 more seats. Add that to the 16 they started with and you're looking at somewhere around a 26-seat Republican gerrymandering advantage in November. All of it drawn, not won.
### **36.**
That's where this is headed after the next census, by the 2032 election, if nothing changes.
The [Brennan Center projects](https://substack.com/redirect/158185cc-30d1-46d4-9f84-e10800c5be05?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that population shifts will hand the South nine new House seats after 2030. The biggest winners are Texas and Florida, the same states most willing to rig their maps. Meanwhile California and other blue states are set to lose seats after the census. Stack that on top of everything else and the Republican advantage would climb to around 36 seats.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/158185cc-30d1-46d4-9f84-e10800c5be05?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And here's the gut punch. That Southern growth is coming mostly from communities of color. The same voters Republican map-makers are best at cracking apart and drawing out of power. Those voters are the ones handing these states more seats to gerrymander.
So follow the line. 16, then 26, then 36. Each step, the map gets more rigged, and the voters matter less. Left alone, this ends in a House where Democrats can win the popular vote by a lot and never win the majority. That's not democracy. That's a rigged game with a nice-sounding name.
### **What this means for the midterms.**
Here's the same rigged map, measured a different way.
The nonpartisan [Cook Political Report](https://substack.com/redirect/af40743e-4100-4f18-abf5-fadee9f3968d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) looked at every district after this year's GOP map-rigging and found that the typical House seat now leans about 3 points more Republican than the country as a whole. Before the gerrymandering war, it was about 1 point more Republican. Now the middle of the map sits well to the right of the middle of the country.
Here's what that does to a normal election. Out of all 435 seats, only 77 are remotely competitive, the ones that sit within 5 points either way of the national average. Those are the seats that actually get decided by voters. Everything else is locked in before Election Day once people vote in their primaries. And to win a majority, Democrats have to win 57 of those 77 swing seats. That's 74%. Republicans only need to win about a quarter of them.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b01b92c1-e0ed-4d70-843e-e90e7ebf0491?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Think about how lopsided that is. In a fair system, if the country splits 50-50, the House splits close to 50-50. Now it doesn't. Democrats are fighting with one arm tied behind our backs. We start three points down and have to sweep nearly three out of every four battleground seats just to squeak out a majority. We can still win, thanks to a President who is totally inept and running our economy into the toilet. But we have to win big just to win at all, and that's exactly how the MAGA extremists who drew the maps want it.
And here's what should terrify Republicans. They rigged the maps this hard, tilted the whole country three points in their favor, and Democrats are STILL favored to take back the House in 2026. Think about that. They cheated as much as they possibly could, and it might not be enough to save them. That's how badly this is going for them, and it's why they're so desperate to rig the next map too.
### **Here 's the truth about how we fix it.**
I've lived this. Republicans in Raleigh gerrymandered me out of my fair, 50/50 seat in Congress. So while I was still in Congress [I wrote a bill to end gerrymandering](https://substack.com/redirect/34e35597-6130-4008-8a5c-9424ca5f4c8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for good. It's called the FAIR MAPS Act. The idea is simple: take map-drawing away from politicians in every state and hand it to independent, nonpartisan redistricting commissions made up of regular citizens. [Duke researchers](https://substack.com/redirect/65cf0a28-0a35-4051-8c3d-1877952784ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) found it would roughly double the number of competitive seats in the House. It would also make the kind of mid-decade power grab we just watched totally illegal.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bfc64937-9b9f-4164-93e1-709b6c778da8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Politicians can't be trusted to draw their own maps. History has made that clear. The only real fix takes the pen out of all their hands for good.
But a good bill isn't enough. You have to be able to pass it. And this is the part I won't sugarcoat.
The House can pass fair maps. If Hakeem Jeffries is Speaker, my bill will pass the House right away. The wall is the Senate, where the filibuster lets a future GOP minority kill it. So here's the honest path, plainly stated. We need a Senate willing to set the filibuster aside for legislation that protects democracy itself. And we need a president in 2028 who will sign fair maps into law. Nothing less gets it done. Not a lawsuit. Not one good election. Not waiting it out. The game is rigged at the level of the maps, and only a federal law can un-rig it.
### **Trust Democrats to Deliver**
Now, why trust Democrats to actually do this? I'll give you the honest answer, because I think it's more convincing than a promise. Democrats will win more seats with fair maps.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b01b92c1-e0ed-4d70-843e-e90e7ebf0491?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Our interests and the public's interest point the same way. The current rigged system helps Republicans more than Democrats. That means Democrats are the ones incentivized to tear it down. When doing the right thing and helping your own party line up perfectly, that's a promise you can take to the bank. You don't have to trust our hearts. You can trust the math. Democrats benefit from fair maps -- and by the way, so do voters in the center.
So that's the fight. A Senate that will set aside the filibuster for democracy. A president in 2028 who will sign the fix. And fair maps that finally let voters pick their politicians instead of politicians picking their voters.
This fight isn't complicated. Republicans rigged the maps because they can't win a fair fight. So we have to take the pen out of their hands, in every state, for good.
I'm in this fight. If you are too, [follow me on Social Media](https://substack.com/redirect/aafd8ae0-fecb-4177-acdc-f8fad33892be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and let's get to work. Please feel free to share your thoughts in the Substack comments and I'll try to answer as many questions as I can.
-Wiley
P.S. This fight costs money. If you believe voters should pick their politicians instead of the other way around, please [pitch in today](https://substack.com/redirect/bfc64937-9b9f-4164-93e1-709b6c778da8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and help me keep at it. Anything helps.

Peter,
**If you’ve turned on the TV recently, you know the Republican midterm media blitz is officially in full swing here in North Carolina.**
That’s why we’re rolling out a new survey to a select number of supporters to gauge how your news intake is impacting your view on our campaign, this Senate race and Roy Cooper himself. [_**We want to hear from you – so please: Will you fill out our quick survey before 11:59 p.m. tonight?**_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19554?code=email_fr_pros_jtk1273&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=8&akid=3087%2E124072%2EusRhGM)

subject: Are you ready for next week, Peter?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire, Dan Gray, Treasurer, 45 Lafayette Rd
body:
We have one week to get voters to the polls on Election Day...

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/15boR05uyKW?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70)
| | | | | | Peter,

**Seven days...**

That’s all that stands between now and the Republican Primary that will decide who gets the chance to fight for New Hampshire in Concord.

I’ve said it before, and I’ll say it again...**We cannot afford to sit this one out.**

If we do not show up next Tuesday, September 8th, our legislature will be filled with people who call themselves _Republicans_ but sell out our values, our freedom, and our way of life every chance they get.

Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire has done our homework. We spoke with the candidates. We learned where they stand. **That is why we have officially endorsed 54 liberty champions who have signed The Pledge** and made a public promise to fight for you.
[**See our full list of endorsed candidates by clicking here!**](https://us.list-manage.com/19WFiELrjwi?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70)

| | **We have one week to get voters to the polls on Election Day.**

Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire has teams on the ground knocking doors and speaking with voters about these important races, but we need all hands on deck.

**If you want to help Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire knock more doors before the Tuesday, September 8th, primary election, you can go to:** [www.CitizensAllianceNH.org/donate](https://us.list-manage.com/2iJhu1nkVnz?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70) **and sponsor a doorknocker for $175!**

If you’ve already donated, start a group chat with your friends, family members, neighbors, and coworkers and encourage them to make a plan to vote next week.

**If we want the best of the best on the ballot in November, we have to show up next week.

**Mark your calendar. Make your plan. Talk to the people around you.

Then get to the polls next Tuesday, September 8th, and vote for the Pledge Signers who will stand for liberty.

LET’S WIN!

**Joe Males is a Marine Veteran, small business-owner, city council member, and most importantly, a father. Throughout his life, he has put service to his community at the forefront of his life’s mission.

If you want to understand the priorities of the United States House of Representatives, look no further than the drinking fountain--or rather, the bottle placed suspiciously beside it. While the nation argues about debt ceilings, infrastructure, and whether cookies should be classified as a breakfast food, Congress has quietly been dropping millions of taxpayer dollars on something truly revolutionary: water that comes in plastic containers instead of pipes.

That's right. In a building connected to some of the finest municipal water infrastructure on planet Earth, our elected representatives have managed to spend over $4 million on bottled water. Not sparkling. Not infused with cucumber and a faint whisper of elderflower. Just regular H2O, in bottles, trucked in, probably with a markup that would make a stadium vendor blush.

Now, let's be fair. The Capitol is a stressful workplace. You're voting on bills you haven't read, fleeing from tourists who think you're the gift shop cashier, and occasionally sprinting through hallways to make quorum calls. Staying hydrated is important. But here's the thing: Washington, D.C. tap water is perfectly safe. The city literally pipes it in, filters it, tests it, and delivers it to virtually every room in the Capitol complex with the miracle of indoor plumbing--a technology we've apparently decided to treat like a quaint historical artifact, like powdered wigs or bipartisan cooperation.

Taxpayers fund what should be free | | | Sep 1| | | ∙| | Preview ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | If you want to understand the priorities of the United States House of Representatives, look no further than the drinking fountain--or rather, the bottle placed suspiciously beside it. While the nation argues about debt ceilings, infrastructure, and whether cookies should be classified as a breakfast food, Congress has quietly been dropping millions of taxpayer dollars on something truly revolutionary: water that comes in plastic containers instead of pipes. That's right. In a building connected to some of the finest municipal water infrastructure on planet Earth, our elected representatives have managed to spend over $4 million on bottled water. Not sparkling. Not infused with cucumber and a faint whisper of elderflower. Just regular H2O, in bottles, trucked in, probably with a markup that would make a stadium vendor blush. Now, let's be fair. The Capitol is a stressful workplace. You're voting on bills you haven't read, fleeing from tourists who think you're the gift shop cashier, and occasionally sprinting through hallways to make quorum calls. Staying hydrated is important. But here's the thing: Washington, D.C. tap water is perfectly safe. The city literally pipes it in, filters it, tests it, and delivers it to virtually every room in the Capitol complex with the miracle of indoor plumbing--a technology we've apparently decided to treat like a quaint historical artifact, like powdered wigs or bipartisan cooperation. | | ---|---|--- Continue reading this post for free in the Substack app | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Heartland Journal 99 E. Peter, Last month, I sent you an urgent message about the Tarrant County Commissioners Court planning to close polling places. Today, the GOP majority is proposing to close 92 polling places in one of the largest and most competitive counties in Texas.
**The first time these closures came to a vote, I stood with residents and gave public comment against it.**
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138321729/643745158/-742812207?refcode=du_em_090126_tc_i1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3NDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTU4ZGEzOWUtMDdhNi1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAyMjQ4MmE5YThkIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=t7nvWgiAEWviVIngK09pb0Okfo2iplgxdwd9fxaFBnk=)

**Today, I’m back in Tarrant County.**
I’m on the ground, standing with community leaders and the Tarrant County residents who are watching their elected officials try to strip away their most basic right.
Every registered voter in Tarrant County who followed the rules, got on the rolls, and expects a ballot and a polling place to be open near them on Election Day _is being betrayed. _
Closing nearly a third of their polling places means longer lines for the midterms. Longer lines mean fewer votes. And this is Tarrant County — the third largest, most competitive county in Texas. The same county where Taylor Rehmet flipped a Senate seat in January.
**This is what voter suppression looks like in 2026, and[ I am not going to let that stand.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138321730/643745159/-742812207?refcode=du_em_090126_tc_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3NDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTU4ZGEzOWUtMDdhNi1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAyMjQ4MmE5YThkIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=t7nvWgiAEWviVIngK09pb0Okfo2iplgxdwd9fxaFBnk=)** As Lieutenant Governor, I will fight every single effort to make voting harder in this state. __That work starts right here, right now, in Tarrant County.__
Let's hold the line.
Rep. Vikki Goodwin

name: Alex Vindman
subject: What Comes Next
body:
What I'll be doing going foward...

🇺🇸 A short note before you get to my message below. 🇺🇸
Going forward, I'll return to writing on my **[Why It Matters Substack.](https://act.alexvindman.com/go/1701?t=1&akid=1096%2E3892029%2EPEwD-v) **
There I'll talk about politics, national security, foreign policy, veterans and military affairs, and the other subjects where my experience gives me something useful to contribute. I have missed discussing these ideas with you and I also want to use that space to think through some of the questions this campaign left me with. I hope you'll give it a follow.
**[JOIN ME ON SUBSTACK](https://act.alexvindman.com/go/1701?t=2&akid=1096%2E3892029%2EPEwD-v)**
_Starting over, and a few things I’ve been thinking about since the primary._
Peter –
I wanted to be writing something different after my primary. Of course I'm disappointed by the outcome, but elections don't always go the way we plan or hope. You take stock, learn what you can, and figure out what comes next.
But before I say anything about what comes next, I want to say thank you.
Since January, we traveled across Florida and met tens of thousands of people who welcomed us into their communities, donated, volunteered, offered advice, told me what I was getting right and also what I was getting wrong (perhaps I should have listened to those people more!). They trusted me with their stories and their concerns about their families, their communities, and the country. I'm grateful for all of it, and I will carry it with me always.
Now I need to start over, and that's something I've had to do before.
In Here, Right Matters, I included some of the lessons I had learned over the course of my life. One was: Start Over—and Keep Starting Over.
At the time, I was writing about leaving the Army. I didn't want to start over. I loved the Army and had spent more than two decades building a career there. But circumstances changed, and eventually I had to accept that the future I had imagined for myself wasn't going to happen.
Well, here I am again. And it seems to me our nation is in a similar place.
America is at an inflection point. We've been approaching it for years, but I think the elections of 2016 and 2024 made it impossible to deny. The status quo isn't working for a lot of people, and our politicians have been too slow to understand the depth of people's dissatisfaction.
I heard it daily while traveling around Florida.
People are working hard and still falling behind. Housing, healthcare, groceries, and childcare cost too much. Young people wonder if they'll ever be able to afford a home. Parents worry whether their children will have fewer opportunities than they did. This reality exists across the political spectrum.
They look at Washington and see a government that largely seems incapable of, or uninterested in, meaningfully addressing any of it. They see business as usual while many are living in crisis. It's no secret that wealthy people and corporations have access and influence in a way they never will. They read about members of Congress trading stocks while writing the laws. They see billions of dollars spent on campaigns that nevertheless leave them feeling unrepresented in Washington.
People are angry and increasingly willing to reject anything that resembles the establishment. I didn't fully understand the depth of that frustration during my own campaign, and I didn't connect with enough voters who were looking for something different. I missed the mark. There's no point in asking Democrats to learn from this moment if I'm not willing to do the same.
The frustration is real, and it's warranted.
In 2020, I thought Trump's defeat meant the country had rejected what he represented. In fact, in Here, Right Matters, I wrote about “moving together out of” the Trump presidency.
Then he came back. Whatever we thought we had settled in 2020, we hadn't. Democrats need to be much more curious about why.
Our campaign has substantial resources remaining, and I'm going to put them to work. We have already put nearly $1 million to work and plan to invest substantially more.
We'll focus on competitive races in Florida, veterans running for office around the country, and Democrats with a realistic opportunity to win Senate seats. This is a project that will endure beyond the 2026 election cycle.
I'm going to be selective. I want to help candidates who understand the moment we're in: people willing to address the cost of living and an economy that isn't working well enough for working people; take on corruption and the influence of money in politics; strengthen our democracy; reject antisemitism and other forms of bigotry regardless of where they come from; and work with people they don't agree with on everything.
As for my own next role, I don't know exactly what I want to do, but I do intend to continue to serve and have an impact in my community and my country. I cannot imagine not serving in some capacity.
One thing life has taught me is that your role isn't always the one you planned for. I didn't plan to become an impeachment witness or a public figure, and a few years ago I wouldn't have predicted I would run for the United States Senate.
I've had to change course before, and I've learned that changing course isn't the same thing as abandoning the mission.
For now, part of my role will be here with the Why It Matters Substack.
I'll continue writing about politics national security, foreign policy, veterans and military affairs, and the other subjects where my experience gives me something useful to contribute. I have missed discussing these ideas with you, but I also want to use this space to think through some of the questions this campaign left me with.
Why have so many Americans lost faith in our institutions? What does a Democratic economic agenda look like if we start with people's lived experience rather than political labels? How do we build a coalition broad enough to defeat MAGA without being afraid to disagree with one another? How do we make government work well enough that people have reason to trust it again?
**[The path back to the White House and a lasting victory begins with the work we do now. If you believe in this mission and want to support my mission to help veterans get elected and rebuild the Democratic party in Florida, I need you to pitch in and become a paid subscriber.](https://act.alexvindman.com/go/1701?t=3&akid=1096%2E3892029%2EPEwD-v)
**[JOIN ME ON SUBSTACK](https://act.alexvindman.com/go/1701?t=4&akid=1096%2E3892029%2EPEwD-v)**
I have thoughts about all of those things. I don't have all the answers.
Running for office has a way of reminding you of that.
I don't know exactly what comes next. But I've had to change course before, and wishing the terrain were different doesn't change the terrain in front of you.
So I'm going to take some advice I gave myself years ago.
Start over. And keep starting over.

I have thoughts about all of those things. I don't have all the answers. Running for office has a way of reminding you of that. I don't know exactly what comes next. But I've had to change course before, and wishing the terrain were different doesn't change the terrain in front of you. So I'm going to take some advice I gave myself years ago. Start over. And keep starting over. ** Paid for by the Alex Vindman Victory Fund, a joint fundraising committee authorized by Alex Vindman for Florida, the Democratic Executive Committee of Florida and the DSCC. 4611 S University Drive #194 Davie, FL 33328

Every word in this letter comes directly from me, and I hope you’ll spare just a minute to hear me out.

Let me start off by saying the rising tide of socialism in this country should have real Americans terrified.

**First, it was Zohran Mamdani in New York. Then, it was Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan. Now, another Far Left socialist just won a Democrat Senate primary in Florida in a stunning upset!**
---
But here’s the part that truly keeps me up at night: _The Far Left keeps winning _without_ money_.
---
The socialist who just won in Florida didn’t even have enough cash to run a single TV ad!
---
So how do they keep pulling it off? Well, they’ve stolen the GOP’s secret weapon from 2024: **_Good old-fashioned political organizing!_**
---
At the end of the day, winning in modern America isn’t about the flashy stuff like polling, TV ads, or money. The _ONE_ and _ONLY_ thing that decides elections are verified votes!
---
_That’s how President Trump and the GOP defeated Kamala Harris even as she spent over**$1 BILLION** against us!_
---
**But right now, the Democrats – and especially the Far Left – are beating MAGA at our own game by lapping us in voter enthusiasm, voter verifications, and voter turnout.**
---
If we don’t retake the lead before early voting gets underway in just a few weeks, our Republican House Majority is as good as gone!
---
**That is why I’ve made it my mission to personally reach out to every single GOP voter on file whose voter verification is still not 100% complete.**
---
**You were one of those voters, so I took the unprecedented step of getting your email from the GOP’s database so I could contact you DIRECTLY.**

With time running out, your verification has never been more vital.

Thank you,

# Mansharamani Musings
---
| | [](https://us.list-manage.com/YQCCQk_bdex?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586)During August, I wrote about restive youth around the world...and specifically about the cockroach revolution in India. Other topics that caught my attention included Guyana’s booming economy, the quantum computing revolution, our K-shaped economy, and the boom in humanoid robotics. I also had a chance to speak with Sanjiv Yajnik, President of Capital One’s auto finance effort, and Billy Webster, a successful entrepreneur who ran for Governor of South Carolina. Links to my writings and interviews are below...
Best wishes for a thought-filled September!_**
- Vikram**_

| | **AUGUST 2, 2026**

A wave of youth-led protests has been sweeping the globe, and it is [unlike anything we’ve seen since the Arab Spring](https://us.list-manage.com/lKGvyfIxmJ9?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586). Over the past three years, Gen Z protesters have toppled governments, stormed parliaments, and forced presidents to flee their own palaces. [Bloomberg suggests the unrest is being driven by a generation “crushed by soaring rents and living costs and staring down a future where robots and AI threaten their jobs](https://us.list-manage.com/18dRXXNsmpk?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586).” The protests are leaderless, organized on TikTok and Discord, and spreading across three continents with a speed that has caught governments completely off guard.
Here’s the scorecard (so far): Sri Lanka (2022), Bangladesh (2024), Kenya (2024, 2026), Serbia (2024), Nepal (2025), Indonesia (2025), Morocco (2025), Philippines (2025), Madagascar (2025), Tanzania (2025)... see full post for details on these and others!
**And don’t forget about the United States.** That same generational frustration and economic anger are fueling the rise of democratic socialism and leading to the elections of far-left candidates across the country, most notably in New York City...

| | **AUGUST 9, 2026**

Let me tell you about the luckiest country on Earth, one most people have never even heard of. Guyana is a former British colony on the northern coast of South America with a population of **800,000 people** , fewer than Austin, Texas. In 2015, ExxonMobil was drilling in the waters off Georgetown, Guyana and struck oil. What they found was staggering: [over 11 billion barrels of recoverable resources](https://us.list-manage.com/YTwzKFYLeP7?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586) in the Stabroek Block, one of the largest discoveries of the 21st century. In just 11 years, Guyana went from [zero to 903,000 barrels per day](https://us.list-manage.com/E6D2hBwqLpu?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586), one of the fastest production ramp-ups in the history of global oil.
The numbers are staggering. Guyana has been and continues to be the [fastest-growing economy on Earth](https://us.list-manage.com/xWEY58rFLVy?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586), with GDP growth of **43.6% in 2024, 19.3% in 2025, and a projected 16.2% in 2026**. It is now the [11th richest country in the world by GDP per capita](https://us.list-manage.com/BgDMs2WHL47?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586). The government has taken in [$6.2 billion in oil revenues](https://us.list-manage.com/GfJYAUoSK_w?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586) as of late 2024, and this year’s annual revenue is projected to exceed $3 billion. A fifth offshore project, the [$12.7 billion Uaru development](https://us.list-manage.com/bDX6G6Tn2Zw?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586), comes online this year, which will drive production past one million barrels per day. By 2030, Guyana could be pumping [1.9 million barrels per day](https://us.list-manage.com/WRlTZTLUF3J?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586), becoming South America’s second-largest producer behind Brazil (and ahead of Venezuela)....

| | **AUGUST 16, 2026**

The most dangerous weapon in the world doesn’t exist yet, but the damage it will cause may already be done. The weapon is quantum technology, which has the potential to disrupt almost every form of communication and the protection of secrets, especially when it comes to national security. And the worst part is it’s already too late to stop the damage it will do.
But first, a quick detour into the physics of quantum computing. Every computer you’ve ever used stores information in **bits** , tiny switches that are either 0 or 1. Every email, every photo, every encrypted military communication, is just a very long string of 0s and 1s that are processed very fast. Quantum computing is not just an incremental improvement in speed, it’s fundamentally different. Instead of bits, it uses **qubits** , which can be 0, 1, or (and this is the part that makes my brain hurt) _both at the same time_. A qubit exists in both states simultaneously until you measure it. (This is where Schrödinger’s cat comes from—the cat is both alive and dead until you open the box.) While my PhD physicist friends may say I’m oversimplifying the difference, I’ve come to think of quantum computing as probabilistic and traditional computing as binary...

| | **AUGUST 22, 2026**

According to the headlines, the American economy is doing fine. Not great, not terrible, but fine. [GDP grew 2.0% in Q1 2026](https://us.list-manage.com/vNdNykVz8C2?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586). Employment seems stable-ish. Inflation, while still above the Fed’s 2% target, looks like its moderating. The [CBO projects continued economic expansion](https://us.list-manage.com/64EMdbYZ8xg?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586) through the end of the year. Consumer spending is holding up, particularly at the upper end. The stock market is near all-time highs. Corporate earnings are strong, especially in tech.
Yet despite this news, most Americans are worried. Consumer confidence is far from ebullient. And the US economy is shed more jobs than it created in July. I’ve spent a career looking past headlines and connecting seemingly irrelevant and disparate dots. And the mosaic I’m putting together is forming a deeply concerning image...

| | **AUGUST 29, 2026**

Regular readers know that I have written quite a bit about AI and the breathtaking speed at which it has grown. Dario Amodei, the CEO of Anthropic, [described the trajectory](https://us.list-manage.com/DXswGmufNXn?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586) as heading toward “a country of geniuses in a datacenter.” It sure feels like the future will be filled with machines that can already outthink most humans in most domains. But it’s not just intellectually where the machines are surpassing us. It’s physically too.
Being outperformed by a machine is nothing new. After all, cars and tractors and factories full of equipment have been doing so for centuries. But the development of humanoid robots, machines built to resemble humans that walk on two legs with two moving arms, has been advancing at accelerating rate. Further, the humanoids are increasingly becoming _autonomous_.
All of this was on full display during the recent [World Humanoid Robot Games](https://us.list-manage.com/Wa3R6rhaZbq?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586) in Beijing. Held at the National Speed Skating Oval, the very venue the PRC built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the competition brought together [over 2,000 humanoid robots from 666 teams across 16 countries](https://us.list-manage.com/iM0WOYme9wq?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586). The robots competed in 51 events, from sprinting to soccer and table tennis to kickboxing. [**More than 40% of the events required fully autonomous operation**](https://us.list-manage.com/LCSmECswe2n?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586). And by fully autonomous, I mean that there were no human operators with joysticks, remote controls, or intervention of any kind. These robots operated on their own...

body:
#

Good morning, friends.
Today is September 1, 2026. As someone who cares about ending the gun violence crisis in our country, we have some numbers you need to see:
**Over 90%**
That’s the percentage of Americans who support universal background checks before buying a firearm — including a majority of gun owners, non–gun owners, Democrats, and Republicans. Now, extremists in Congress want to weaken our gun laws.
**$46.6 million**
The NRA has spent nearly $50 million to get Trump into office. They were the BIGGEST outside spenders in his first election. With less than 75 days until the midterms, the gun lobby will spend BIG to protect their extremist candidates and stop our progress.
**4**
Democrats can win back control of Congress by flipping just four seats in the House and four seats in the Senate. We can then work to stand up against the Trump administration’s attacks on gun safety and expand legislation to protect our communities. But it won’t be a shoo-in.
**$4**
That’s the amount Gabby needs you to contribute today. Grassroots donations to emails like this one are a huge source of fundraising for GIFFORDS. If a lot of people donate right now, we can reach more undecided voters before ballots go out in our top races.

| | Friend, When Congress allocates taxpayer dollars, it is bound by the Constitution to demand oversight and safeguard fundamental civil rights. Instead, congressional Republicans handed ICE and Border Patrol over **$240 billion** in locked-in funding through 2029. They wrote a blank check while explicitly rejecting commonsense constitutional guardrails—voting down mandates for body cameras, independent investigations, and judicial warrants. The human cost of this unchecked power is catastrophic:
* **Fatal Encounters:** At least 10 people have died in operations since this crackdown began, including U.S. citizens and working parents.
* **Arbitrary Arrest Quotas:** Federal agents are forced to pursue 3,000 daily arrests, pulling investigators away from fentanyl and child exploitation cases just to hit numbers.
* **Zero Internal Discipline:** Out of 22,000 ICE officers, not a single one has been disciplined despite 56 formal complaints of excessive force.

That is what reporters do.The response from a sitting United States Senator's office was to start talking about prosecuting me for it.Patriot, this has become a pattern, and I want you to see it as clearly as I have come to see it over the last three weeks.Last week the Secretary of State of Minnesota published a statement accusing my journalists of “lying, lawbreaking, and disruptions” and announced that law enforcement is reviewing them. He never named a single law we broke.This week the office of a United States Senator is talking about prosecuting a journalist to the fullest extent of the law.Michigan. Minnesota. Alaska. Three states in three weeks, and every single time we have gone looking, we have found the same hole sitting there in plain sight. Nobody ever rushes to close the hole. They come after the person holding the flashlight. me tell you what Alaska cost.$50,000What this single investigation cost to produce — so that you could hear two words said out loud at a folding table in Anchorage.That covered the flights to Anchorage and back, the weeks of preparation before anyone ever got on a plane, the records work, the equipment, and a team standing on the ground at dawn on primary day three thousand miles from our office. It also covered the lawyers who reviewed every frame of that footage before a single second of it went to air, because we understood exactly what was coming the moment it did.I would spend every dollar of it again tomorrow morning without blinking. Here is my problem. And there is a next one. There is always a next one.Alaska is not special. Alaska is simply the state we happened to be standing in on Tuesday, and everything you are about to watch came out of a single morning and one honest question asked out loud at a folding table. Imagine what is sitting untouched in the other forty-nine.In twenty-eight days, the first federal ballots for November go out. After that date the machine is running, and everything we have not found yet gets voted on anyway.You and your family have to live under whatever comes out of those buildings, and so does mine, and that is the entire reason I keep walking into them with a camera when it would be far easier and considerably safer not to.There is nobody else writing this check, and there never has been. It has always been you. you for everything you do.In Truth,James O'KeefeFounder, O'Keefe Media GroupP.S. The video is called “The Big Murkowski,” and I hope it makes you laugh. name: Senator Maggie Hassan
subject: I’m proud to endorse Stefany Shaheen
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Maggie for NH
body:
| When Stefany Shaheen and I first got to know each other, it wasn’t through politics.

It was as two moms, both raising children with significant health challenges. We both understood firsthand what it means to fight to make sure that your child gets the health care, support, and inclusion that they deserve.

[**_Those experiences shaped both of us — and I’m proud to put my support behind Stefany as she takes that fight and determination all the way to Congress. That’s why I’m endorsing her, and I’m hoping you will join me in supporting her by chipping in $10 or more today, split between Stefany and me._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138333013/643775721/2049458448?amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.09.01_Stefany-Shaheen-Endorsement_B1_F1_S1_C1_90OP_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2UxYzI4Ny0wZmE2LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vHTnNw6U0msO6zig79yWq1lvZV13-ZyvxfIHmkoE38Q=) | | **[SPLIT A DONATION>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138333014/643775722/2049458448?amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.09.01_Stefany-Shaheen-Endorsement_B1_F1_S1_C1_90OP_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2UxYzI4Ny0wZmE2LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vHTnNw6U0msO6zig79yWq1lvZV13-ZyvxfIHmkoE38Q=)**
---
Stefany has served her community on the Portsmouth City Council, is an entrepreneur, and has a clear vision for how to improve the lives of Granite Staters.

At a moment when this administration and RFK Jr. undermine public health, weaken vaccine guidelines, and cut medical research, we need to elect people who will champion health care access and fight back.

I know a lot of people are asking for your support right now, which is why I want you to know how much it means to have you on my team. Sixty-three days from now, voters across the South Sound will decide this race, and voters across the nation will determine whether Democrats take back the House. Between now and then Washingtonians will be knocking doors, making calls, and making sure every eligible voter in our state knows how to return their ballot safely and securely. We will be prepared to stand up for mail-in voting and any attempt to interfere with its validity. If you want to make our work more consistent and easier to plan, consider becoming a weekly donor.
